_comment: Files that still cast the Supabase client and may keep doing so at no more than this count until their owner moves them onto pendingClient (gap/00 D2). Counted: .from()/.rpc() arguments cast as any or never (as never is allowed only where pendingClient is called), the client cast as any, and declarations typed any that hold the client (counted once where defined). Seeded 22 Nov 2026 with 32 files and 130 casts. Re-seeded 22 Nov 2026 (Phase 0 audit round 2) with 37 files and 149 casts: the scanner now reads the AST, so it sees expression arguments (.from(tableName as any)), as never, rpc calls with arguments after the cast, and any-typed aliases (const supabase: any = supabaseClient), and only pending.ts itself is exempt. That added 5 files and 19 casts once; it does not license new ones. Only shrinks: see src/test/config/pendingTables.test.ts.
